claims.disproof_condition: 條件：表後燃氣電廠的許可、整合商申報或客戶文件普遍寫明不配 BESS（只靠機組本身處理負載擺動），或 ProPetro 之後的申報寫出 60 MW 案改成不含電池。核查頻率：每季。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 BESS 是必需層還是選配層，調整這條邊與反向路徑的 confidence。
claims.statement: ProPetro's PROPWR 60 MW long-term contract for a hyperscaler data center in the US Midwest (2025-10-27) uses a hybrid system combining battery energy storage (BESS) with natural gas reciprocating engine generators, designed to manage rapid load swings — BESS appears as a component of this onsite gas power design. The BESS supplier is not named.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：ProPetro 之後的申報寫出 60 MW 合約終止、延後部署，或 PROPWR 退出資料中心。核查頻率：每季（ProPetro 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence。
claims.statement: ProPetro (PROPWR division) committed 60 MW of power under a long-term contract to a leading hyperscaler data center operator in the US Midwest, deployment slated from Q2 2026, using gas reciprocating engines plus BESS. The hyperscaler is not named.

sources.quote: its PROPWR ℠ division has secured a long-term power supply contract to commit 60 megawatts of reliable energy to support a leading hyperscaler data center ope rator in the Midwest region of the United States.

Under the terms of the contract, PROPWR will deploy an innovative hybrid energy system that combines battery energy storage solution (BESS) technology with high-efficiency natural gas reciprocating engine generators.
This advanced configuration is designed to effectively manage rapid load swings, ensuring continuous, stable power delivery while enhancing grid resiliency and operational flexibility.
Deployment and operations are slated to begin in Q2 2026
